topic: Testosterone's role in bone density for men and women
caption: Did you know testosterone plays a crucial role in maintaining bone density for both men and women? 🦴💪 Low testosterone levels can lead to osteoporosis and increased risk of fractures. 🤕 Here are some key facts about testosterone and bone health: Testosterone helps regulate bone resorption and formation. 🔄 It also helps maintain bone density by stimulating osteoblasts. 🌟 In men, low testosterone can lead to a loss of bone mass and increased risk of osteoporosis. 🚨 In women, testosterone therapy can help improve bone density in post-menopausal women. 🌸 Save this so you don't lose it.
